description: This Java source file defines an exception mapper class for handling LinkedAccountRequiredException within a Fineract-based application. It provides a mechanism to convert specific exceptions into HTTP responses with detailed error responses.

classes.name: LinkedAccountRequiredExceptionMapper
classes.description: A component class that maps LinkedAccountRequiredException to an HTTP response.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts a LinkedAccountRequiredException into an HTTP 403 Forbidden response with a domain rule violation error payload.

methods.name: errorCode
methods.description: Returns a specific error code (3002) associated with this exception mapping.
